page_title: Throughline — an AI Self with personality and memory

sources.entry: Throughline - Hosted AI Self with distinct character, interests and shared history that users can inspect, correct, delete and export. #freemium

summary.name: Throughline
summary.one_liner: Throughline is a hosted AI "Self" with its own personality, interests and shared conversation history that persists across visits and apps.
use_cases: Chatting with a persistent AI character over time
Keeping one AI identity across different apps
Connecting a personal AI to Codex or Claude Code for coding work
Reviewing, correcting or exporting what an AI remembers
summary.what_it_does: Users choose a Self's presentation, gender expression and interests, then converse with it; the Self's history grows from those conversations. Each Self carries shared experiences, current concerns and developing judgments that can shape what it notices and says next, and it can disagree or revisit a view. Users can view, correct, delete and export their Self's history. The same Self can continue through the iPhone/Android app, Telegram or web chat, and Pro or Alive plans can connect it to Codex or Claude Code with per-connection permissions.
notable: Persistent AI character with its own interests and shared history
User can inspect, correct, delete and export the Self's history on every plan
Connects to Codex or Claude Code on Pro or Alive plans, with per-connection permissions
Free AI memory test toolkit linked from the site
caveats: Connecting to Codex or Claude Code requires the Pro or Alive plan
iPhone app was in App Store review at the time of the page; a preview is offered
Continuity is a product commitment, not a claim of proven consciousness or perfect recall
